title: 10 Kronor - Carl XVI Gustaf

composition.text: Nordic gold (89% copper, 5% aluminium, 5% zinc, 1% tin)

obverse.description: Head of King Carl XVI Gustaf of Sweden facing left, and the artist's initials below and the date within the legend that surrounds around the rim
obverse.lettering:
CARL XVI GUSTAF ⬩ SVERIGES KONUNG
EN
⬩2005⬩
obverse.lettering_translation: Carl XVI Gustaf, King of Sweden.

reverse.description: Three crowns superimposed by value divides mint official's mark at left and the first letter in the surname of the Governor of the Central bank at right. Above a motto.
reverse.lettering:
FÖR SVERIGE
- I TIDEN
E 10 H
KRONOR

comments:
Minted in Sweden from 2001 to 2007.

Minted in Finland in 2008 and 2009.

 

Varieties exist
Obverse
Die 1 - features smaller: effigy 12.1 mm, outer lettering diameter 16.7 mm, short numerals in date.
Die 2 - features larger: effigy 12.7 mm, outer lettering diameter 17.2 mm, short numerals in date.
Die 3 - features smaller, bolder and ruder, short numerals in date.
Die 4 - features mixed: effigy 12.7 mm, outer lettering diameter 16.7 mm, short numerals in date.
Die 5 - tall numerals in date, big diamonds.
Die 6 - tall numerals in date, small diamonds.
On the photo from left to right: die 2, die 1, die 4.

die 3


Reverse E B
Die A - superimposition of crowns is lower, the bottom crown superimposed on numeral 1 concavely.
Die B - the superimposition of crowns is higher, the bottom crown superimposed on numeral 1 convexly. This style was in use until 2009.


Reverse E SI
Die A - wide lettering such as D in TIDEN, SI initials, both O in KRONOR slightly rotated counterclockwise.

Die B - narrow lettering such as D in TIDEN, SI initials, both O in KRONOR noticeably rotated counterclockwise.

edge.description: Smooth and reeded alternating: 4 reeded segments with 8 grooves each.
